g.text: KESTREL K1 — Battery hatch A (B mirrored), rear service door
Material: PA12 (HP MJF) · Process: MJF + bead blast
Tolerances: gasket land flat 0.3 · Finish: primer + satin warm white
Dimension from the STEP model; general tolerances per docs/09 §2. Break sharp edges 0.2–0.5 mm. Projection: isometric, hidden lines grey.
